transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because I keep making these small mistakes on things. Like... on applications, or my research notes. Just small things, like mislabeling an artwork date or skipping a question entirely. And... I don't know, it's just kind of embarrassing, because I honestly thought I had checked them before turning them in. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Do you often find it hard to focus or sustain your attention on tasks, even when you're trying your best?

Um... I don't really know. I think my focus is mostly fine. It's just... like I said, I just make those mistakes when I'm writing things down. I haven't really noticed having a hard time paying attention, though. Just... yeah. I don't think so.
Do you often have trouble organizing your tasks or keeping your work materials in order?

Um... yeah, I guess. Things get... a little cluttered. Like, my apartment and my laptop, they just... kind of look like a bunch of half-started projects. Just... rent papers, or gallery notes, article PDFs... they sort of end up everywhere. And... I don't know, I just have a hard time figuring out what actually needs to happen first. So... yeah.
Do you often find yourself forgetting things or getting distracted easily, even during everyday tasks like running errands or keeping track of appointments?

Um... yeah, sometimes. I'll mean to do just... normal stuff. Like returning an email, or paying a bill... maybe getting groceries. And then... I don't know, a few days go by and I realize I never actually did it. It just sort of... drops out of my mind, I guess.
Looking back, did you have similar issues with forgetfulness, disorganization, or making careless mistakes when you were a child or in school?

Um... yeah, I suppose. Even back in... elementary school, I guess. My teachers would write that I had good ideas, but... I don't know, I just forgot to turn in my worksheets a lot. Or I'd lose the instructions... miss little details. Things like that. My parents basically had to... check my backpack every night to make sure I had everything. So... yeah.

Do these issues with forgetfulness, disorganization, and making mistakes happen in different parts of your life, like at work, at home, and in social situations, or do they mostly happen in one place?

Um... I guess it's pretty much everywhere. Like... at my apartment, or when I was taking classes. Even just... hanging out with people, sometimes I forget what we planned. It's not really just one place. It just kind of... happens.
Have you noticed any recent changes in your mood, stress levels, or life circumstances that might be contributing to these difficulties with memory and organization?
Um... no, not really. Nothing's really changed. I mean, I'm not... overly stressed or anything. Things are pretty much the same as they've always been.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself needing to be constantly moving, like you can't sit still for very long?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I can sit still fine.
Do you find these issues affect you even in situations where someone else is directly supervising or guiding you, like at a job or during a group activity?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess if someone is right there watching me or... telling me what to do, I usually do okay. I haven't really noticed it being a problem then.
Do you often feel impatient or find yourself blurting out answers or interrupting others before they finish speaking?
Um... no. I don't really do that. I usually just... let people finish.
